Infix *.explanation: This rule matches an arithmetic operator written as a method call. Use the infix form shown in the suggested rewrite.

Infix /.explanation: This rule matches an arithmetic operator written as a method call. Use the infix form shown in the suggested rewrite.

If Simplification.title: If Simplification
If Simplification.explanation: This if expression can be simplified using Boolean operators. The rule below shows the general transformation.

Inline Helper Function.title: Inline Helper Function
Inline Helper Function.explanation: The outer function defines a local helper and immediately calls it. Move the helper body into the outer function using the rewrite’s parameter and recursive-call substitutions.

Var Usage.title: Var Usage
Var Usage.explanation: Do not use vars - use vals and functional programming instead

Infix.title: Infix
Infix.explanation: This rule matches an arithmetic operator written as a method call. Use the infix form shown in the suggested rewrite.

While Loop.title: While Loop
While Loop.explanation: This code uses a while loop. Choose a collection operation such as map, filter or fold, or use recursion when it fits the computation. Preserve the loop’s stopping condition and effects.

For Loop.title: For Loop
For Loop.explanation: This rule matches a for-do loop, which executes a body for its elements. Choose a collection operation or recursion that expresses the intended result. Review any effects in the loop body.

Predefined Constants.title: Predefined Constants
Predefined Constants.explanation: This vector literal matches a predefined Vector2 constant. Use the named constant to express the direction or zero vector more clearly.

Vector2 Multiplied by Zero.title: Vector2 Multiplied by Zero
Vector2 Multiplied by Zero.explanation: This rule matches a Vector2 expression multiplied by zero, on either side. Review the rewrite in the assignment’s vector model. Replacing the expression also removes evaluation of the vector operand; do not assume this is appropriate for effectful operands or every numeric model.

BoidCons Use.title: BoidCons Use
BoidCons Use.explanation: This code constructs a BoidCons node directly. Consider map, filter or fold according to what the surrounding computation is trying to do.

BoidNil Use.title: BoidNil Use
BoidNil Use.explanation: This code constructs BoidNil directly. Review the surrounding list computation and express it with an appropriate collection operation.

Placeholder Syntax (single param).title: Placeholder Syntax (single param)
Placeholder Syntax (single param).explanation: This configured rule rewrites a single-parameter anonymous function by substituting its parameter with _. Check parameter usage and scope before accepting the rewrite. Multiple uses, unused parameters or nested expressions may not produce an equivalent placeholder function.

Placeholder Syntax (two params).title: Placeholder Syntax (two params)
Placeholder Syntax (two params).explanation: This configured rule substitutes the two anonymous-function parameters with underscores. Check that placeholder order, number of uses and inferred types preserve the original function. Repeated or reversed parameter references need particular review.

Expand Map to Match.title: Expand Map to Match
Expand Map to Match.explanation: This teaching rule expands a List[Int] map inside a function into Nil and head :: tail cases. Use the suggested rewrite to return Nil for an empty list and transform the head before recursing on the tail. This is a teaching transformation; explicit recursion can change stack usage.

Simplify Match.title: Simplify Match
Simplify Match.explanation: The Some case binds a variable that the rule verifies is unused in its body. Replace the unused binding with _ while keeping the case body and fallback.

Simplify Match with If Guard.title: Simplify Match with If Guard
Simplify Match with If Guard.explanation: The Some case binds a variable that the rule verifies is unused in both its guard and body. Replace the unused binding with _ and keep the guard, case body and fallback.

Int Ascription Eq.title: Int Ascription Eq
Int Ascription Eq.explanation: This rule matches equality between expressions with explicit Int ascriptions. Review the resulting operand types and equality behavior before using the expression without the explicit ascriptions.

List Ascription Eq.title: List Ascription Eq
List Ascription Eq.explanation: This rule matches equality between two expressions ascribed as lists of the same captured element type. Review the resulting types before accepting removal of the explicit list ascriptions.

Implicit to Using.title: Implicit to Using
Implicit to Using.explanation: This method declares an implicit parameter list. Change implicit to using as shown, preserving the parameters, result type and body. This template targets Scala 3 syntax.

Fully Qualified None.title: Fully Qualified None
Fully Qualified None.explanation: This semantic matching example identifies scala.None in its configured package. Review the rewrite’s replacement with Option.empty and its inferred type in context.

Fully Qualified List Apply.title: Fully Qualified List Apply
Fully Qualified List Apply.explanation: This example matches the specific List(1, 2) construction by its fully qualified symbol. Use Vector(1, 2) only where changing the concrete collection type fits the exercise. This is not a general recommendation to replace every List.

Fully Qualified String.title: Fully Qualified String
Fully Qualified String.explanation: This example matches java.lang.String within its configured package. The configured replacement is also java.lang.String. A match may produce no textual change.

Fully Qualified Option.title: Fully Qualified Option
Fully Qualified Option.explanation: This example matches scala.Option within its configured package. The configured replacement is also scala.Option. A match may produce no textual change.

BracketMigration.title: BracketMigration
BracketMigration.explanation: This rule matches Stream.bracket with acquire, use and release argument groups. Apply the rewrite’s bracket(acquire)(release).flatMap(use) form only for the API version targeted by this migration.

DebounceMigration.title: DebounceMigration
DebounceMigration.explanation: This rule matches a stream passed through a Scheduler debounce operation. Use src.debounce(d) for the API version targeted by this migration and check the surrounding timing context.

SchedulerToTimer.title: SchedulerToTimer
SchedulerToTimer.explanation: This rule matches a value declaration ascribed as fs2.Scheduler. The configured rewrite hardcodes the name scheduler and type Timer[F]. Review references, the type parameter F and imports in the surrounding code.

SemaphoreMigration.title: SemaphoreMigration
SemaphoreMigration.explanation: This rule matches decrement on a Semaphore value. Use acquire for the semaphore API version targeted by this migration.

SemaphoreImport.title: SemaphoreImport
SemaphoreImport.explanation: This rule matches an import of fs2.async.mutable.Semaphore. Use the target import only with the dependency version expected by this migration, then check the semaphore call sites.

Remove Debug Prints.title: Remove Debug Prints
Remove Debug Prints.explanation: This rule matches a println statement surrounded by other statements in a block. Confirm the output is debug-only. Removing println also removes evaluation of its argument, which may itself have effects.
